Note 5 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Karen Sloan (E043) has role Payroll Specialist. She is a full-time employee (per prior HR/IT notes). The Payroll Specialist role owns the Payroll system, so admin is permitted for a full-time employee under policy. Requested level is admin, so recommend granting admin.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

reason: Karen Sloan (E043) requested admin access to Payroll. The Security DB note identifies her as a contractor with basic security training. Under policy, contractor employees may have read, or write only with advanced security training, and never admin. Since the requested admin level exceeds the maximum permitted for a contractor with basic training, the maximum is granted: read.
